status: Draft-preparation checklist; not a submission-ready certification

requirements: File: unlocked DOCX (DOC/RTF also accepted); English, double-spaced, single-column, at most three heading levels, page numbers, continuous line numbers, no footnotes.
Titles: full at most 250 characters; short at most 100; sentence case.
Order: title/authors/affiliations page, abstract, introduction; Methods/Results/Discussion; Acknowledgments, references, supporting captions.
Abstract: at most 300 words, objectives/method/results, no citations; avoid abbreviations.
References: numbered square-bracket citations in first-appearance order, Vancouver format; verify current metadata.
Cover letter: separate, at most one page; contribution, prior work, research-article type, prior PLOS contact, suggested editors, opposed reviewers; fee support elsewhere.
Tables: editable, inserted after first citation.
Funding: financial-disclosure submission field only, not manuscript.
No overall article word or figure-count limit.

policy: Describe replicable statistical methods in Methods, software versions, procedures and code identifier.
Identify independent units versus repeated measurements, design factors, sample-size rationale, exclusions, missing data, randomization and any blinding.
Explain assumptions, transformations, outlier treatment, selection procedures and multiple-comparison handling where applicable.
Report numerator/denominator with percentages, defined variability measures, effect sizes and confidence intervals when appropriate.
For significance tests, state alpha and exact p values when at least 0.001. Supply full fitted regression results as supporting information when applicable.
Make plot-level observations accessible. Publicly registered protocols need their actual accession/DOI; protocol supplements are allowed.
project_specific_actions_not_additional_: Treat worlds as independent experimental units; do not count repeated questions as independent replications.
Separate exploratory head selection and failed development validation from the completed 64-world confirmation and conditional 30-world repair test.
Label practical go/no-go thresholds as practical criteria, not statistical significance.
Keep numerical failures, unsupported cases and negative controls visible; describe conditional case selection and small causal cohorts.
Local dated/hash-sealed plans are not a journal Registered Report or proof of public preregistration.

policy: A Data Availability Statement is required at submission.
The data and metadata necessary to reproduce every reported finding must be unrestricted and public by publication, absent justified legal/ethical restrictions.
A suitable public repository is strongly recommended. State its name, real persistent identifiers and available licensing information.
Accessible supporting data may substitute for repository deposition; use reusable machine-readable formats. Each supporting file must be smaller than 20 MB.
The policy does not automatically require every unused raw file. Define the finding-reproduction minimum explicitly.
data_availability.project_status: Complete development and confirmation native measurements are public in native-data-20261116-v1, with matching archive/source checksums, successful transfer receipts and anonymous-link verification. The v0.2.0 package contains the updated paper and complete text-outcome data. Large arrays are separate release assets, not embedded in Git or S1 Data. Private cloud storage is not used as the public deposit. No permanent archive DOI is claimed; author review of journal-policy compliance and long-term preservation remains required.
release_inventory_to_finalize: Prompt/world definitions, labels, seeds, counterbalances, tokenization metadata and case IDs.
All reported natural/intervention outputs, control outcomes and analysis-ready per-world observations.
Frozen protocols, source manifests, custody/audit receipts and environment/model revision details.
Native logits/attention/kernel evidence sufficient to reproduce the reported audits and mechanism analyses; document any omitted unused arrays.
data_availability.statement_template_unusable_until_filled: Data supporting the reported findings are available at [PUBLIC REPOSITORY NAME, REAL PERSISTENT IDENTIFIER, LICENSE]. [Identify separately deposited large reproducibility artifacts and supporting tables.]

code_availability.policy: Author-generated code underlying findings is expected to be publicly available without restrictions by publication, reusable and documented. A persistent-ID archive, explicit open-source license, dependency documentation and access instructions in the Data Availability Statement are recommended. Do not conflate recommendations for analysis code with extra requirements for software-as-the-main-contribution articles.
code_availability.project_action: Prepare an immutable, tested release with exact environment/model versions and reproduction commands; choose the license and archive, obtain a real identifier, then replace the placeholder. Review redistribution rights for third-party models/libraries separately.
code_availability.placeholder: [PUBLIC CODE RELEASE URL, COMMIT/RELEASE, PERSISTENT IDENTIFIER, LICENSE]

AI_disclosure.policy: Research/content assistance, including code generation, must be disclosed. Identify tools, affected work and output-validation procedures in Methods or Acknowledgments; figure-related assistance also belongs in relevant legends. AI cannot be an author. Humans retain accountability; language-only editing exemption does not cover this project.
AI_disclosure.proposed_statement_for_human_confirmatio: OpenAI Codex [model/version and use dates to confirm] assisted with protocol development, software and tests, automated experiment execution, computational audits, analysis and manuscript drafting. Computational checks included deterministic rescoring, native-output replay, tests and hash-bound provenance records [confirm exact included checks]. [Describe the human authors' actual independent review of code, raw results, references, interpretations and final text.] The listed authors approved the final work and accept responsibility for its accuracy and integrity [confirm before use].
open_items: Confirm exact AI tools/models/versions where recoverable; do not invent a model identity.
Confirm the full research role and affected figures/supporting files.
State actual human review, not an unverified claim that humans independently checked everything.

figures.publication_specs: Final main figures: separate TIFF/EPS files; 300–600 dpi; width 6.68–19.05 cm, height at most 22.23 cm; smaller than 10 MB; Arial/Times/Symbol text 8–12 pt. TIFF: flattened, LZW-compressed, no alpha channel, one page. Use RGB or grayscale. Combine panels per figure.
figures.captions_and_order: Match numbered filenames, citations and captions. Put captions after the paragraph of first citation, not inside the figure. Upload each figure separately.
figures.initial_submission_caveat: The journal waives figure formatting until provisional Editorial Accept; publication requires compliance.
figures.project_action: Export exact data plots and check readability, denominators, units and underlying data links. Illustrative diagrams must not imply stronger causal results than measured.

supporting_information.requirements: Any file type is supported; DOCX is allowed, not mandated. Use whole-number S labels, match filenames and manuscript captions. Captions with item number/name belong at the manuscript end; a short title is recommended. Files are published as supplied without copyediting. In-text supporting citations are recommended, not compulsory or necessarily sequential.
supporting_information.size_reconciliation: The dedicated page recommends files below 10 MB; the submission/data pages set a below-20-MB requirement. Target below 10 MB and put large evidence in a public repository.
supporting_information.project_action: S1 Appendix.docx is a useful optional package, not a universal journal-required supplement format. Supply reusable data separately rather than only in DOCX tables.

fit_and_claim_limits.policy: Original computational research fits the journal's scope. Negative/null findings are considered, but controls, replication, adequate sampling and conclusions supported by evidence remain necessary. Derivative or replication work needs a sound rationale and explicit relation to existing work. Preprints are allowed; simultaneous submission elsewhere is not.
fit_and_claim_limits.project_application: Frame as a bounded empirical study of alias-dependent retrieval errors and limits of a specified causal intervention. Do not claim discovery of an abstract entity representation, absence of entity coding, or broad mechanistic sufficiency from a small selected head/cohort. Final abstract/result numbers must match completed audit receipts.

author_confirmations.authorship: Confirm substantial human contributions, approval, accountability, author order and agreed CRediT roles. All corresponding authors need ORCID at submission, authenticated by acceptance; only each author can authenticate. Obtain permission for named acknowledgments.
author_confirmations.funding: [CONFIRM ALL SUPPORT PER AUTHOR, GRANTS, COMPUTE/IN-KIND SUPPORT AND FUNDER ROLE; DO NOT ASSUME NO FUNDING]
author_confirmations.funding_policy: Every submission needs an online Funding Statement; disclose sources, grant numbers and funder roles, including an explicit no-role statement only if true.
author_confirmations.competing_interests: [CONFIRM FINANCIAL AND NONFINANCIAL INTERESTS FOR ALL AUTHORS; DO NOT ASSUME NONE]
author_confirmations.interests_policy: Disclose relevant potential interests from the past five years and older interests if reasonably perceived as competing.
author_confirmations.ethics_scope: [CONFIRM SYNTHETIC COMPUTATIONAL STUDY ONLY: NO HUMAN PARTICIPANTS, PERSONAL DATA, ANIMAL WORK OR OTHER APPROVAL-REQUIRING ACTIVITIES; DO NOT INVENT AN ETHICS APPROVAL]
author_confirmations.related_work: [CONFIRM RELATED MANUSCRIPTS/PREPRINTS AND NO SIMULTANEOUS SUBMISSION]
author_confirmations.publication_costs: [AUTHOR TO CHECK CURRENT APC, INSTITUTIONAL COVERAGE OR ELIGIBILITY FOR SUPPORT BEFORE SUBMISSION]

outstanding_author_actions: Review and take responsibility for the science, code, citations, limitations and final text.
Resolve identity, contribution, funding, interest and AI-use placeholders.
Authorize and complete an actual public data/code deposit; test anonymous access and replace persistent-ID placeholders.
Complete final audit reconciliation, file formatting and one-page cover letter review.
Recheck live journal policies at actual submission; this retrieval records 2026-11-15 requirements.
not_authorized_by_this_checklist: Fee payment or new cloud resources
